sample_unit: survey respondents (rheumatology healthcare professionals and researchers)

links.outcome: Self-rated AI knowledge and digital confidence among rheumatology staff
links.effect: Only 6% self-rated their AI knowledge as excellent; one in four reported excellent confidence in digital technology; 64-66% wanted education on safe LLM use and ethical/safe AI use.
links.quote: One in four reported excellent confidence in using digital technology, with only 6% self-rating their AI knowledge as excellent.

screen.reason: Survey examining real-world adoption, perceptions, and concerns regarding AI use among rheumatology clinicians and staff.
